s00-01-story-bc1f20.wav.text: They wanted to build a tower that reached heaven.

s00-02-talk-fbf9a7.wav.text: But the funniest line in the story is about how small it really was.

s01-01-story-67b144.wav.text: After the flood, Noah's family grew into a whole people.

s01-02-grave-2bb92a.wav.text: Now the whole earth had one language and the same words.

s01-03-story-301d49.wav.text: They settled on a wide plain, and learned to make bricks, and to bake them hard in fire.

s02-01-pivot-6aebad.wav.text: And then they had an idea.

s02-02-grave-d45e3f.wav.text: Come, let us build ourselves a city and a tower with its top in the heavens,

s02-03-grave-1d30ff.wav.text: and let us make a name for ourselves.

s02-05-story-f191ad.wav.text: To make a name for themselves. To never need him again.

s03-01-pivot-437ba6.wav.text: But listen to what happens next.

s03-02-grave-d0c168.wav.text: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of man had built.

s03-03-talk-d7364c.wav.text: The tower that was meant to reach heaven was so small, God had to come down to see it.

s04-01-story-56a776.wav.text: So God mixed up their language.

s04-02-story-b5df88.wav.text: Suddenly no one could understand each other.

s04-03-story-ca2530.wav.text: So they stopped building, and scattered across the earth.

s04-04-grave-b4e3bb.wav.text: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth.

s05-01-pivot-729c3a.wav.text: Centuries later, in Jerusalem, God came down again.

s05-02-story-ab3f09.wav.text: This time as fire, on Jesus's followers.

s05-03-story-f9dffd.wav.text: People from every nation were there, and something amazing happened.

s05-04-grave-9b2e5e.wav.text: Each one was hearing them speak in his own language.

s06-01-talk-3770ee.wav.text: At Babel, people tried to climb up to God, and were scattered.

s06-02-pivot-42498a.wav.text: At Pentecost, God came down to us, and started gathering them back.
